comments.author: Jon D. (Overcat)
comments.content: What a great improvement!  What are all the operators available with lists?

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
The addition operator lets you add two lists together, or add an element to a list:

  newlist = list1 + list2
  newlist = list1 + newelement // element added at the end
  newlist = newelement + list1 // element added at the beginning

Subtraction lets you remove an element from a list.

I've currently got the multiplication operator set up so you can merge lists. list1 * list2 will return a combined list, but any elements in both list1 and list2 will only appear once.
